description: Chair Greyeyes reported on Peter Ballantyne Cree Nation Urban Reserve signing.

chips.text: Peter Ballantyne Cree Nation Urban Reserve signing ceremony held May 1, 2025.

description: Deputy Chief Pringle received the Order of Merit of Police Forces.
Saskatoon Police reported a 19% decrease in evade incidents in 2024.
44% of evade incidents in 2024 involved stolen vehicles.

chips.text: Saskatoon Police Service employees received awards for exemplary service.
Red Dress Day events observed for Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls.

description: Saskatoon Police reported fewer evade police incidents in 2024.
Pursuits decreased 19% from 2023, continuing a five-year trend.
Most incidents involved adults, 44% stolen vehicles, no serious injuries.

chips.text: Chief McBride noted expanded air support hours contribute to pursuit terminations.
Majority of persons involved in evade incidents are adults (96%).
Police vehicle damage from evade incidents was not reported.

description: Saskatoon Police reported 264 use of force occurrences in 2024.
New reporting system makes direct year-over-year comparisons difficult.
Board requested per capita use of force reporting in future.

chips.text: Most complaints about excessive force are deemed unfounded after investigation.
Prisoners requiring extreme control are subject to restraint chair or strap use.
New 'blue team' reporting system establishes a new baseline for future comparisons.
How Saskatoon's use of force data compares to other Canadian cities remains unclear.
SPS committed to providing per capita use of force measurements if requested.
